reason: Mixes HBV-infection contrasts ("HBV-infected HCC => Uninfected HCC"), HCV-infection contrasts ("HCV Infected => Uninfected Control"), HCC tumor-genotype baselines ("Hepatocellular carcinoma, ctnnb1_status_wt"), NBNC-HCC viral-negative tumor controls, and an unrelated "Lung Lung squamous cell carcinoma Pt73_M" control under one "Hepatitis C virus" anchor.

Pools vaccine-timecourse contrasts ("Vaccination Day 2 => Vaccination Day 0", "Post-vaccination Treated ... => Pre-vaccination Control") with a separate NAAT carriage-status axis ("MenACWY CT NAAT result: +ve => MenACWY CT -ve") - vaccine response vs infection/carriage status are two different questions.

Mixes RTS,S/AS01 vaccine pre/post contrasts ("RTS,S/AS01 012 Day of Challenge => RTS,S/AS01 012 PreVAC"), a different vaccine platform ("Ad35.CS+RTSS+RTSS...=> Control - Reference Blood"), CHMI infection-challenge donor timecourses ("Infected - after_second_inf_C7 => Uninfected - before_first_inf_baseline"), and unrelated in-vitro "Media D0/D90/D150" controls.

Genuine Q-fever contrasts ("Monocytes from Donor_X with QFS => ...healthy control") are mixed with an unrelated prostate-cancer/ADT contrast ("CD4lowHLA-G+ T cells from prostate cancer patients undergoing ADT => Healthy human naive CD4 cells") and an unclear "150kV => Control" pair with no infection relevance.

Pools many distinct respiratory viruses under "Control CV" (adenovirus/rhinovirus/RSV/influenza/coronavirus etc "at AV"), a separate SARS-CoV-2 Day0/10/35/41 timecourse, and an unrelated HIV/Tetanus/HepB vaccine trial ("Tetanus mo(0)+ALVAC...+AIDSVAX...+HepB => Placebo V5").

Treated side mixes different drugs under one compound label: Osimertinib-vs-DMSO contrasts dominate but "Adagrasib_100mpk... => Vehicle_A2" (KRAS inhibitor), "CUTO28...+entrectinib => ...+none" (ROS1/TRK inhibitor), and "EBC-CR2/3+capmatinib => EBC-1" (MET inhibitor) are unrelated drugs pooled in.

Only 2/7 contrasts are actual Pam3CSK4-vs-DMSO pairs; the rest are a different adjuvant ("GLA-SE => Alum"), heat-killed mycobacteria ("HKM 24hr => Untreated 24hr"), an HTLV-1/TCQ drug study, and a generic unrelated "Drug Treated Clinical Response => Clinical Response Baseline".

Gilteritinib contrasts are diluted by unrelated compounds sharing generic vehicle labels: LSD1 inhibitor+5-Aza, TP0903 (AXL inhibitor), PD173074 (FGFR inhibitor) vs "MS49/MS55 negative control", BIO/SR1/MeBIO (GSK3/AhR modulators), and a Diamond-Blackfan-anemia steroid contrast.
"HCT116 K7174 => HCT116 untreated" uses a different compound (K7174) than the two genuine staurosporine (STS)-vs-DMSO contrasts.

Treated arms span unrelated compound classes (2-Deoxyglucose, betahydroxybutyrate, dexamethasone "DEX", estradiol "E2 Treatment", decitabine "DAC", a PKA inhibitor) all compared to generically-labeled "Control (breast)"/"Vehicle Control".

Mixes plain androgen/DHT-vs-vehicle contrasts with drug-combo arms (DHT+ABBV-075/744/ENZ, androgen+IMTPPE/JJ-450), an AR-degrader without DHT, and a genotype-vs-genotype pairing ("LNCaP_androgen_induction => LNCaP_AR_silencing") that swaps a pharmacological baseline for a genetic-knockdown baseline.

Only "HUDEP-2 cells treated with IAA => ...without IAA" is a true IAA contrast; the rest are food-allergen exposures (2S albumin/7S globulin), ART antiretroviral treatment, statins, and an anti-CD3 antibody (hOKT3) study, all under the "indole-3-acetic acid" anchor.

No contrast is actually pure "LPS alone vs untreated": treated arms are unrelated compounds MC3209/MC3465 vs DMSO, an unclear "NR" vs Basal, "TPL2i+LPS => Vehicle+LPS" (control already contains LPS), and "Uric Acid+LPS => Control Monocytes".

Beyond estradiol(E2)-vs-vehicle pairs, treated arms include unclear/different compounds "1-S"/"1-SO ... => DMSO without UV" and "MDA-MB-231 treated with B5 => ...CTRL", plus a genotype-confounded pair ("MCF7+transgene+E2 => MCF7+wildtype PELP1+vehicle").

Every contrast is "Calcitriol/1alpha,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 X => Ethanol vehicle" at matched timepoints - internally consistent single perturbation vs single vehicle type (canonical anchor name "anisole" is mislabeled but the contrast itself is coherent).

Every contrast is DHT ("5α-dihydrotestosterone") vs matched ethanol/vehicle within the same genetic background (shCon/shKLF5-2/Bag-1L mutant/WT) - a consistent androgen-vs-vehicle design across cell-line contexts, paired correctly within genotype.

Treated side mixes plain "Estradiol => Vehicle" with combo "Estradiol and Fulvestrant => Vehicle control" (an added ER-antagonist) - a different pharmacological question layered onto the same vehicle-labeled control.

Anchor "testosterone" pools BRAF/MEK-inhibitor melanoma contrasts ("BRAFi on Pt1 D85 => Baseline tumor biopsy Pt1"), a TPA/IDC contrast, a progestin study ("...treated with R5020... => ...Vehicle"), a pirfenidone contrast ("PFD-treated => PBS-treated"), and an HCC tumor-vs-paratumor disease contrast - none involve testosterone.

Only "BxPC3 cells treated with Gemcitabine => PDAC cells treated with vehicle" names gemcitabine; the rest use unclear/different agents (BI00923406, "A"/"T", CM03 in Gem-resistant cells, unnamed "Combination", SOP1812) against DMSO/untreated controls.

Combines clear trastuzumab/Herceptin/biosimilar contrasts with a combo arm ("Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab => Untreated (normal)") and a generically labeled "HER2+ Breast Tumor Biopsy Treated with Drug => ...Vehicle Control" that does not specify the drug.

Genuine cisplatin-vs-vehicle contrasts are mixed with unlabeled "Combination" arms ("A549...Combination => ...Vehicle"), a generic "chemotherapy" arm, and a structurally different platinum compound ("MRC5 Tetra-Pt(bpy) => MRC5 control").

All 5 contrasts are actually bleomycin (not physostigmine - a labeling issue) but they mix a two-drug combo ("Bleomycin and PDKIN => Vehicle Control", no PDKIN-only control), a genotype-confounded pair ("Bleomycin with transgene (additional) => Control without transgene"), and a distinct genetic background ("bleomycin (STING deficiency) => untreated") without matched genotype controls.

"Dox" is overloaded: real doxorubicin-chemo contrasts ("MDA-MB-231 Doxorubicin => MDA-MB-231 Untreated", "MCF-7 ADM => MCF-7 growth medium") are pooled with doxycycline-inducible transgene systems ("T47D...FOXA1_plus_Dox => ...FOXA1_minus.Dox", "ZR75-1...Dox => ...Dox_vehicle") plus unrelated compounds "FMF-04-159-2", "Compound_18", and "AV535".
